stories.title: Specialty Match Score Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define the output schema for specialty match scoring including fields for input condition, matched NUCC codes, match confidence score, and explanation metadata. Ensure compatibility with existing provider evaluation flows.

stories.title: Core Specialty Match Accuracy Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic to compute match accuracy between user condition and provider specialties using NUCC taxonomy mappings, leveraging existing specialty identification pipelines.

stories.title: Evaluate Care Integration Endpoint
stories.description: Expose specialty match accuracy through the Evaluate Care facade, enabling downstream consumption in provider evaluation workflows.

stories.title: Unit Tests for Specialty Matching Logic
stories.description: Develop unit tests validating specialty match scoring across common, edge, and mismatched condition scenarios using NUCC taxonomy inputs.

stories.title: End-to-End Integration with Provider Evaluation Flow
stories.description: Integrate specialty match accuracy into the full provider evaluation pipeline, ensuring scores are computed and returned as part of evaluation responses.
